ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR52] Requires Marketplace? on moving into Negotiation only, for Digitization/Information Governance/InSight deals. PPL values corrected per IRM feedback. Stage narrowed to Negotiation-only per IRM's answer for this Solutioning...
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Renewal') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Digitization'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Information Governance'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'InSight') ),
OR( AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation') ) ),
ISPICKVAL(Marketplace__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Marketplace? is required to advance to the next stage. Please select a value.
